text: Reports described merger discussions between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb. Neither company confirmed a transaction. The reported combination would represent an approximately $400 billion enterprise. Equity prices diverged during trading while the reported structure remained unconfirmed.

meta.note: Transaction status remains unconfirmed, limiting classification to the reported structural configuration.

text: The FAA certified the Boeing 737 Max 7 following completion of its safety review process. Certification authorizes entry into commercial service after operator preparations. The approval followed required design modifications, including changes to the engine anti-ice system, flight control software, and crew alerting system.

meta.note: Certification applies to the Max 7 model; commercial service timing remains operator-dependent.

text: The U.S. president publicly stated that ExxonMobil and Chevron earned excessive profits and called for lower retail fuel prices. The companies reported elevated quarterly earnings while no regulatory action or pricing directive was announced.

meta.note: Public statements were recorded without accompanying policy or enforcement measures.
